assets.final_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production prop sprite for Soul Meter, a 2D isometric CRPG.
Style/medium: gothic mythopunk. Semi-realistic painterly digital illustration — closer to dark-fantasy concept art than to flat vector/pixel art or a clean 3D-kit render. Rich surface detail (wear, rust, moss, wet sheen) rendered through paint-like shading rather than flat color fills or hard cel outlines.
Lighting: dramatic, directional key light with a darker falloff/vignette around the subject. Avoid flat, evenly-lit "asset kit" lighting — every piece should look like it was lit for atmosphere, not for orthographic clarity alone.
Palette: Base surfaces: charcoal/near-black stone, blue-black masonry, wet dark iron.
Institutional metal: iron and tarnished bronze, reserved for ceremonial/important elements (see the brazier's warm firelight accent against cold stone).
Magic/the Wound: restrained violet, cyan, pale bone-white — used as small local accents, never an all-over glow.
Organic life: deep moss/algae green, damp peat brown, occasional demon-heat red-orange (see Bog Wight's corrupted growth).
Overall: desaturated and dark by default, with a small number of deliberate saturated accents per asset (fire, magic, decay) rather than broad bright color.
Camera: orthographic 45-degree yaw and 26.565-degree downward pitch, coherent 2:1 isometric edges. Key light from upper left; right-facing surfaces in shadow. Preserve painterly tactile material quality and practical worn construction of the project's Dom crate, iron brazier, and long table.
Composition: a flat ground-surface decal seen from the same isometric camera, lying flat on the ground plane with no height; its outline follows a 2:1 isometric footprint (about twice as wide as it is tall). Square canvas, the patch centred in the middle band of the image, leaving the top and bottom quarters empty. Long straight sides with sunk, slightly ragged edges; the two short ends feather to fully transparent so overlapping pieces blend; other edges soft and irregular, that fade to fully transparent so it blends onto any ground beneath it.
